content.title: SNL Five-Timers Club: What It Is, Who's In It, And Why It's A Big Deal
content.text: April began with the continuation of Zendaya and Robert Pattinson’s promotional tour for their new romantic dramedy “The Drama.” The two stopped by “The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon” ahead of a special New York City screening of the film set for the following evening.On the west coast, “Love Story” star Dree Hemingway (she played Daryl Hannah in the hit Ryan Murphy series) was among the guests at Cultured magazine’s dinner celebrating Bulgari’s Icons Minaudières collection at Chateau Marmont.More from VarietyThe month promises to be packed with back-to-back red carpets and starry events — including the “Euphoria” Season 3 premiere in LA, CinemaCon in Las Vegas and New York City’s LGBT Community Center gala honoring “Heated Rivalry” creator Jacob Tierney, among many others — so make sure to keep coming back here to see the best celeb photos from April 2026.Best of VarietySign up for Variety's Newsletter.
